summary: Iteration 2 — catálogo endpoints + UI flows. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (100%). Validated: /api/localidade returns SANTA CRUZ + CONJUNTO ALUÍZIO BEZERRA/BAIRRO (RN, zona 14); /api/quarteiroes returns 33 docs in numeric order with QT1.soma_imoveis=45; /api/imoveis returns 988 rows w/ UUID id and full field shape; quarteirao/lado/q filters work; case-insensitive 'MARIA' search; QT99 returns []; valid tipo_imovel ∈ {R,C,TB,O,PE,''}; no _id leak; regression on /api/forms OK. Frontend (mobile 420x900): Dashboard 'Cadastro' card renders & navigates to /catalogo; /catalogo shows localidade card, totals, dropdown of 33 QT, QT3 lists 59 imóveis grouped by lado; /form/new auto-prefills municipio='2411205 - SANTA CRUZ', localidade='00246 - CONJUNTO ALUÍZIO BEZERRA/BAIRRO', zona='14'; VisitModal -> 'Buscar no cadastro' (open-imovel-picker) opens ImovelPicker; selecting QT3 → picking imóvel auto-fills visit-quarteirao='3', visit-logradouro='CASA 56 NA G. B.', visit-numero='108', visit-tipo-imovel='O' and closes the picker. Full chain working end-to-end.

issues: Card shows 968 imóveis (sum of quarteirao.soma_imoveis from RG2CAB aggregate) but /api/imoveis collection actually has 988 rows. Source-data discrepancy from the spreadsheet — RG2CAB totals don't match the count of per-QT property rows. Consider showing the true count from /api/imoveis OR documenting that the dashboard reflects the aggregate tabulated in the spreadsheet.

action_items: (Minor) Reconcile 968 vs 988 mismatch: dashboard 'Cadastro' card sums quarteirao.soma_imoveis (968) while /api/imoveis has 988 actual rows. Either switch the dashboard to use the real imovel count (e.g. show count from /api/imoveis or add a `total_imoveis` aggregate endpoint) or document the difference. The 968 comes from the RG2CAB spreadsheet totals which underreport the per-QT row counts by 20.

(Minor pre-existing from iter 1, still applicable) VisitModal binds nullable numerics (depositos_eliminados, larvicida_quantidade, qtde_dep_tratados) directly to <input value=...> → React controlled/uncontrolled warning when server returns null. Use `?? ''` coercion.

Console hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in Catalogo.jsx (line 156) and ImovelPicker.jsx (line 95). Caused by the Emergent visual-editor inspector wrapping dynamic text in <span data-ve-dynamic>. Dev-only noise; not breaking production but worth knowing. If it persists in built output, simplify the option text expression.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/imoveis to_list(5000) — currently 988 rows so fine, but if the catalog grows past 5000 it'll truncate silently. Add pagination or raise the cap with a comment.

Catalogo.jsx & ImovelPicker.jsx sort by `Number(a.lado) - Number(b.lado)` — non-numeric or empty `lado` will collate as NaN. Currently OK because all lados are numeric strings, but consider falling back to alphabetical when NaN.
FormEditor prefill only runs when isNew; it overwrites only blank fields (good — uses `f.municipio || ...`). Pattern is correct.

ImovelPicker.onPick is invoked via parent VisitModal — assumed VisitModal.handlePick spreads quarteirao/lado/logradouro/numero/seq/tipo_imovel into visit state; verified via DOM inspection: visit-quarteirao='3', visit-logradouro='CASA 56 NA G. B.', visit-numero='108', visit-tipo-imovel='O' all set correctly.

import_xlsx.py: discrepancy between RG2CAB totals (968) and per-QT row counts (988) suggests the spreadsheet itself has internal inconsistency or the import counts rows including header/footer differently. Worth re-validating the import logic.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all catalog + prefill + picker flows verified; save-after-pick blocked only by test sequencing (modal still open by design)

seed_data_creation: Catalog data (1 localidade, 33 quarteiroes, 988 imoveis) already seeded by previous import script. Form lifecycle tests use TEST_-prefixed forms with cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog endpoints fully covered in /app/backend/tests/test_catalogo.py. Frontend Playwright on viewport 420x900: visit-card-N click needs `await card.scroll_into_view_if_needed()` + plain click (no force). After picker closes via pick-imovel-{id}, the VisitModal stays open and intercepts pointer events on save-btn; click `save-visit-btn` (Concluir) first to close the modal, then save-btn. ImovelPicker correctly populates visit-quarteirao/lado/logradouro/numero/seq-numero/tipo-imovel from the chosen imóvel.
rca of the issue: Dashboard 968 vs API 988 — Root cause: Dashboard.jsx aggregates `q.soma_imoveis` across quarteiroes (from RG2CAB sheet totals = 968) instead of using the count of imoveis collection (988). The RG2CAB sheet in the source spreadsheet underreports the per-QT row counts by 20 (likely the QT-level totals were typed by the field agent and don't perfectly match the row-by-row enumeration in the QT01–QT33 sheets). Mitigation options: (1) add GET /api/imoveis/count or expose total in /api/quarteiroes summary; (2) compute totals on the frontend from /api/imoveis; (3) accept the spreadsheet's tabulated total as authoritative and label clearly.
